sloka: इदम् रक्षामि भवनम् हेमाया वानरोत्तम ।मम प्रिय सखी हेमा नृत्त गीत विशारदा ॥४-५१-१७॥
transliteration: idam rakṣāmi bhavanam hemāyā vānarottama ।mama priya sakhī hemā nṛtta gīta viśāradā ॥4-51-17॥

translations.english: 'Hema, wellversed in dance and music is a fast friend to me. She granted a boon (that none can resist me) and gave this house of which I am the caretaker.
translations.hindi: भूख से पीड़ित, हम लोगों ने उन फलों को खाया । सो तुमने ` ज्ञानं भूख से मरते हुए हम लोगों की जान बचा ली
